entities.name: Loot Niptil
entities.description: An amnesiac human wizard, left behind after a planeswalker duel, who adventures with Kyyrao and solves a murder in Automatown.

entities.name: Kyyrao Grrenmw
entities.description: A Khyyiani cat warrior who found Loot and took him for her mate.

entities.name: Shinra
entities.description: One of Kyyrao's warriors who attacked Loot and was easily defeated.

entities.name: Corsen Mon Duur
entities.description: A dwarf companion of Loot, forced by Dreadfang to lure Loot to the Peregrinator Complex.

entities.name: Dreadfang
entities.description: A Crookshank Kobold broodlord who lured Loot to the Peregrinator Complex to break a curse and died to a cursed sword.

entities.name: Anayatha
entities.description: A woman said to look like Loot and possibly be his daughter, used as bait by Dreadfang.

entities.name: Sopti Borth
entities.description: An artificer of Automatown murdered in her workshop.

entities.name: Haspian Chastoril
entities.description: A salvager and forger who murdered Sopti and framed Loot.

entities.name: Malkean Feorr
entities.description: An Argivian archeologist who suggested Loot is the lost war priest N'ciczli and helped him at the Justiciar trial.

entities.name: N'ciczli
entities.description: The last and greatest of the Tchoktan war priests, summoned by planeswalkers for duels and never returned.

entities.name: The Justiciar
entities.description: A four-armed hydraulic automaton that tracks the guilty in Automatown's court.

entities.name: Truthsniffer
entities.description: A mechanical dog that follows trails using the law of Contagion and picked out Loot.

entities.name: Automatown
entities.description: A town of artificers where Sopti was murdered.

entities.name: Peregrinator Complex
entities.description: A complex holding a cursed treasure trove.

entities.name: Lord Windgrace
entities.description: A figure to whom Kyyrao made sacrifices in the eastern mountains.

events.summary: Loot is summoned to fight in a planeswalker duel and left behind when it ends, then loses his memory from a blow to the head.
events.quote: Loot was summoned to fight in a planeswalker duel and left behind when it ended

events.summary: Kyyrao's warriors attack the dazed Loot and are easily beaten; the cat warriors nurse him back to health and Kyyrao takes him for her mate.
events.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took him for her mate.

events.summary: Dreadfang lures Loot and his companions to the Peregrinator Complex, using Corsen's family as leverage.
events.quote: were lured there by a Crookshank Kobold broodlord named Dreadfang

events.summary: Loot retrieves the armor Dreadfang wanted, since his nameless state should make him immune to the curse.
events.quote: Loot did as he was told and retrieved the armor.

events.summary: Realizing his own name is cursed, Loot taunts Dreadfang, who attacks with the cursed sword; it turns on him and impales him.
events.quote: The looted sword, now cursed, turned on its user and impaled the kobold.

events.summary: Sopti Borth is murdered, and Loot is arrested because the Truthsniffer picked him out.
events.quote: Loot was arrested for her murder because a Truthsniffer had picked him out.

events.summary: Malkean orders the Justiciar to seek the guilty and it attacks Loot, who dodges and slams it into a wall.
events.quote: Malkean ordered the machine to seek the guilty

events.summary: Loot reads the cameo with a psychometric spell, tosses it to Kyyrao to find the culprit, and freezes the Justiciar's hydraulic fluid; it falls on Haspian.
events.quote: used a spell to freeze its hydraulic fluid

events.summary: Kyyrao beheads the Justiciar and Loot exposes Haspian as the forger who killed Sopti and framed him.
events.quote: He killed her and used the scapegoat ritual to sever all links between himself and the evidence so he could frame Loot.

relations.note: Kyyrao took Loot for her mate.
relations.quote: Upon waking, Kyyrao took him for her mate.

relations.note: Haspian murdered Sopti to hide his forgeries.
relations.quote: He killed her and used the scapegoat ritual to sever all links between himself and the evidence so he could frame Loot.

relations.note: Dreadfang held Corsen's relatives and coerced him.
relations.quote: Dreadfang held Corsen's brother and nephew and forced Corsen to lure Loot to the complex

relations.note: Malkean suggested Loot was N'ciczli summoned from the past.
relations.quote: had been summoned from the past, lost his memory during the battle, and became Loot Niptil
